# DevExpress.Win.TreeList NuGet Package

Contains classes related to the [DevExpress WinForms Tree List control](https://www.devexpress.com/products/net/controls/winforms/tree_list/), a data-aware TreeView-ListView hybrid that displays information as a tree, a grid, or a combination of both. The control supports both data-bound and unbound modes and provides full data-editing capabilities.

## Key Features

* UI and UX customization options: auto node height, node drag-and-drop operations, node and cell selection, customizable previews, unbound columns, pinned columns and bands, scrollbar annotations, breadcrumb navigation, column layout customization, and a comprehensive custom draw API.

* Data shaping and manipulation options: high-speed multi-column sorting, data summaries and aggregates, instant and incremental search, Query Builder, Filter Criteria Editor, Excel-inspired filtering, Auto Filter Row, and Filter Panel.

* Excel-inspired conditional formatting.

* Export to PDF, XLS, XLSX, MHT, CSV, HTML, RTF, DOCX, TXT, and image formats.

* Advanced data editing features: New Item Row, inline editing, editing in a separate form, custom edit forms, edit masks, HTML formatting, input validation, error indication, and copy-and-paste operations for formatted data in TXT, RTF, CSV, BIFF8, HTML, and Unicode formats.

* Node drag-and-drop options: copy or move nodes, accept outer nodes, drag multiple nodes, expand nodes while dragging, and drop nodes as siblings or children.
